tools.description: List assignments across one or more courses, with due dates.

tools.name: get_grades
tools.description: Get this account's grade items for a course, if visible.

Check what grade-related permissions this account has in a

        canviewallgrades=False.

tools.name: list_calendar_events
tools.description: List upcoming calendar events within the next `days_ahead` days.

tools.name: get_calendar_access_info
tools.description:
Check this account's calendar-management permissions -- a
        student account can typically manage its own personal entries
        only, not course/group entries.

tools.name: create_calendar_event
tools.description:
Create a personal calendar entry. IRREVERSIBLE once dry_run=False.

tools.name: delete_calendar_event
tools.description:
Delete a personal calendar entry this account owns. IRREVERSIBLE
        once dry_run=False.

        Call with dry_run=True (default) first, show the preview to the user,

tools.name: get_unread_messages
tools.description: Get this account's unread PLATO notifications.

tools.name: get_unread_notification_count
tools.description:
Get a count of this account's unread notifications (a cheaper
        check than get_unread_messages when you don't need the content).
        Note: PLATO has person-to-person messaging disabled site-wide, so
        this counts notifications only, not conversation messages.

tools.name: list_notices
tools.description: List announcements posted to a course's Notices board.

tools.name: get_notice_detail
tools.description: Get the full text of one notice/announcement.

tools.name: list_qna
tools.description: List questions posted to a course's Q&A board.

tools.name: get_qna_detail
tools.description: Get one Q&A question's text. Does not include replies -- see issue #23.

tools.name: post_qna_question

Post a new question to a course's Q&A board. IRREVERSIBLE and VISIBLE

tools.description:
Get this account's completion status for every activity/module in

        flag (includes tracking rules, e.g. 'must view' vs 'must spend N

tools.name: get_upcoming_action_events
tools.description:
Get Moodle's own "what needs action soon" feed -- assignments due,
        video lectures with a watch deadline, etc. -- sorted by urgency, from
        now onward. Unlike combining list_assignments + get_calendar_events,

tools.name: get_courses_by_timeline
tools.description:
List enrolled courses filtered by Moodle's own timeline
        classification (in-progress/future/past), based on course start/end
        dates. Unlike list_courses (which returns everything unfiltered),
        this answers "what am I actually taking right now" directly.

tools.name: get_grades_overview
tools.description:
Get this account's overall grade for every enrolled course in one
        call. For the individual grade *items* within one course (e.g. each
        assignment's score), use get_grades instead -- this tool only
        returns one summary grade per course.

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.description: List quizzes across one or more courses.

tools.name: get_quiz_attempts
tools.description: Get this account's past attempts at one quiz.

tools.name: get_quiz_best_grade
tools.description:
Get this account's best grade on one quiz, if any attempt has
        been graded.

tools.name: get_quiz_access_information
tools.description:
Check whether this account can currently attempt a quiz, and
        why not if blocked (e.g. time window, password, previous
        attempts exhausted). UNVERIFIED against a real quiz -- call this
        before start_quiz_attempt and sanity-check the result.

tools.name: get_quiz_required_qtypes
tools.description:
List the question types used in a quiz (e.g. 'multichoice',
        'truefalse', 'essay') -- useful to know what kind of answers
        to expect before starting an attempt.

tools.name: get_quiz_feedback_for_grade
tools.description:
Get the grade-boundary feedback text configured for a quiz at
        a given grade (e.g. 'You passed!' / 'Please review chapter 3').

tools.name: get_quiz_combined_review_options
tools.description:
Check which review details (marks, feedback, right answers) this
        account is allowed to see for a quiz's attempts.

tools.name: start_quiz_attempt
tools.description:
Start a new attempt at a quiz. IRREVERSIBLE once dry_run=False --
        consumes one of the quiz's limited attempts. UNVERIFIED against a
        real quiz -- call get_quiz_access_information first and check
        canattempt/preventaccessreasons.

        Call with dry_run=True (default) first,

tools.name: get_quiz_attempt_data
tools.description:
Get the questions for one page of an in-progress quiz attempt.
        Each question's `html` is Moodle's own rendered question form --
        parse it for the actual answer-field names before calling
        save_quiz_attempt_responses/process_quiz_attempt. UNVERIFIED
        against a real quiz.

tools.name: get_quiz_attempt_summary
tools.description:
Get a summary of all questions in an attempt (answered/
        unanswered), across all pages. UNVERIFIED against a real quiz.

tools.name: get_quiz_attempt_review
tools.description:
Get the grade and per-question review for a finished quiz
        attempt. UNVERIFIED against a real quiz.

tools.name: save_quiz_attempt_responses
tools.description:
Save in-progress answers WITHOUT finishing the attempt -- can
        still be changed later. UNVERIFIED against a real quiz.

        Call with dry_run=True (default) first, show the preview to the
        user, and only call again with dry_run=False after they explicitly
        confirm.

tools.name: list_forums
tools.description:
List standard Moodle forums across one or more courses. NOT the
        same as PLATO's notice/Q&A board (use list_notices/list_qna for
        that) -- this covers the separate, less-commonly-used mod_forum
        module.

tools.name: get_forum_discussions
tools.description: List discussion threads in one standard Moodle forum.

tools.name: get_discussion_posts
tools.description: Get all posts in one forum discussion thread.

tools.name: add_discussion
tools.description:
Start a new discussion thread in a forum. IRREVERSIBLE once dry_run=False.

        Call with dry_run=True (default) first, show the preview to the user,
        and only call again with dry_run=False after they explicitly confirm.

tools.name: add_discussion_post
tools.description:
Reply to a forum discussion thread. IRREVERSIBLE once dry_run=False.

        Call with dry_run=True (default) first, show the preview to the user,
        and only call again with dry_run=False after they explicitly confirm.

tools.name: get_course_updates_since
tools.description:
Get what changed in a course since a given time -- configuration,
        completion, grades, submissions, etc. Only reports modules that
        implement Moodle's change-tracking (confirmed: the standard `assign`
        module does; this platform's own custom lecture-file/board/video
        modu

tools.name: get_course_module
tools.description:
Resolve a single course module by its id directly, without
        fetching and filtering the whole course's contents.

tools.name: search_courses
tools.description:
Search PLATO's entire course catalog by name -- not limited to
        this account's enrolled courses (use list_courses for that).

tools.name: get_recent_courses
tools.description: Get this account's recently-accessed courses, most recent first.

tools.name: get_recent_items
tools.description:
Get this account's recently-accessed course modules (files,
        assignments, etc.) across all courses, most recent first.

tools.name: get_starred_courses
tools.description: Get this account's starred/favourited courses, if any.

tools.name: list_video_conferences
tools.description:
List BigBlueButton video-conference activities across one or
        more courses. Joining a meeting is not supported by this server --
        this tool is read-only coverage only. Zoom activities (mod_zoom)
        are not covered -- no real instance has existed to verify against.

tools.name: list_lessons
tools.description:
List Lesson activities across one or more courses. Taking a
        lesson (answering pages) is not supported by this server -- this
        tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_workshops
tools.description:
List Workshop (peer assessment) activities across one or more
        courses. Submitting or assessing work is not supported by this
        server -- this tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_feedbacks
tools.description:
List Feedback (survey) activities across one or more courses.
        Responding to a survey is not supported by this server -- this
        tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_choices
tools.description:
List Choice (single-question poll) activities across one or
        more courses. Voting is not supported by this server -- this
        tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_surveys
tools.description:
List Survey activities across one or more courses. Answering is
        not supported by this server -- this tool is read-only coverage
        only.

tools.name: list_scorms
tools.description:
List SCORM packaged-content activities across one or more
        courses. Launching/tracking a SCORM attempt is not supported by
        this server -- this tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_h5p_activities
tools.description:
List H5P interactive-content activities across one or more
        courses. Attempt results are not supported by this server -- this
        tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_glossaries
tools.description:
List Glossary activities across one or more courses. Reading/
        adding entries is not supported by this server -- this tool is
        read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_database_activities
tools.description:
List Database ("mod_data") activities across one or more
        courses. Reading/adding entries is not supported by this server --
        this tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_wikis
tools.description:
List Wiki activities across one or more courses. Reading/
        editing pages is not supported by this server -- this tool is
        read-only coverage only.

tools.name: list_chats
tools.description:
List Chat (real-time chat room) activities across one or more
        courses. Reading/sending chat messages is not supported by this
        server -- this tool is read-only coverage only.

tools.name: get_user_profile
tools.description:
Get a user's profile, scoped to a shared course (not a global
        user search -- see docs/pii_review.md).

tools.name: get_private_files_info
tools.description:
Get a summary (file/folder count, total size) of this account's
        Moodle private files area.

tools.name: get_user_preferences
tools.description:
Get this account's Moodle user preferences. Note: most of these
        are internal UI state (e.g. which dashboard sections are
        collapsed), not information meaningful on its own.

tools.name: add_private_file

        user removes it via PLATO's own UI. Only works when this server
        is running locally (s

tools.name: get_my_course_groups
tools.description: Get the groups this account belongs to within a course, if any.

tools.name: get_enrolled_users
tools.description:
Get the list of users enrolled in a course (classmates and
        instructors), with their role. Same data visible in PLATO's own
        participant list to any enrolled student.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_unread_messages, get_unread_notification_count, get_qna_detail, get_course_completion_status, get_upcoming_action_events, get_quiz_feedback_for_grade, get_quiz_combined_review_options, get_quiz_attempt_data, get_quiz_attempt_review, get_forum_discussions, get_discussion_posts, get_course_updates_since, list_chats · Private data: get_course_contents, submit_assignment, remove_submission, post_qna_question, download_course_file, get_quiz_access_information, get_course_updates_since, get_recent_items, list_database_activities, get_private_files_info, add_private_file · Public sink: submit_assignment, post_qna_question, download_course_file, process_quiz_attempt, add_discussion_post, get_course_updates_since, add_private_file · Destructive: remove_submission, delete_calendar_event, add_private_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_unread_messages, get_unread_notification_count, get_qna_detail, get_course_completion_status, get_upcoming_action_events, get_quiz_feedback_for_grade, get_quiz_combined_review_options, get_quiz_attempt_data, get_quiz_attempt_review, get_forum_discussions, get_discussion_posts, get_course_updates_since, list_chats · Private data: get_course_contents, submit_assignment, remove_submission, post_qna_question, download_course_file, get_quiz_access_information, get_course_updates_since, get_recent_items, list_database_activities, get_private_files_info, add_private_file · Public sink: submit_assignment, post_qna_question, download_course_file, process_quiz_attempt, add_discussion_post, get_course_updates_since, add_private_file · Destructive: remove_submission, delete_calendar_event, add_private_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
